library.title: Playlists
library.subtitle: Find, preview, and organize fullscreen playback for your screens.

preview.loadError: The playlist could not be loaded.
preview.emptyHint: Add ready content to preview this playlist.
preview.itemError: This item could not be previewed in Studio.

create.title: Create playlist
create.description: Name the playlist and choose how its items are selected.
create.standardDescription: Manually arrange media and Layouts in a timeline.
create.tagDescription: Automatically include ready media that matches tags.

details.title: Playlist details
details.description: Name and description are saved separately from timeline edits.
details.sourceDescription: Choose a manual timeline or let matching ready media appear from tags.
details.tagRequired: Select at least one tag before saving this source.

editor.publishNotice: The playlist was submitted or published. Check Content review for its immutable submission.
editor.inspectorHint: Select a timeline row to edit that item. Nothing is selected.
editor.historyDescription: Every published revision is kept for review and restore.
editor.addLayoutDescription: A Layout plays fullscreen for 30 seconds by default.
editor.noPublishedLayouts: Publish a Layout before adding it to a playlist.
editor.deleteDescription: Screens assigned to this playlist will fall back to their default content. This cannot be undone.
editor.bulkDuration: Updated fixed image durations to {{seconds}} seconds.
editor.widgetAddError: The new Widget could not be added to this playlist.

usage.empty: No Layout, campaign, screen, or schedule plays this playlist yet.

inspector.dynamicNotice: This item is generated by the playlist’s tags. Edit the tag rule in Playlist details to change it.
inspector.playerDefaultsHint: Let the assigned Player decide fit, transition, audio, and volume.
inspector.defaultsOffHint: Turn off Player defaults to set an item override.
inspector.followsPlaylist: This item follows the playlist transition.
inspector.crossfadeHint: Visual content blends while audio changes at the normal item boundary.
inspector.removeDescription: The item leaves the timeline but its media stays in the library. This cannot be undone.

defaults.title: Playback defaults
defaults.description: Use these controls for common authoring changes. Individual items can still be customized from the timeline.
defaults.transitionHintTag: Tag-driven items are generated by the tag rule.
defaults.transitionHintManual: Applies to every item and creates an item-level override.
defaults.imageHintPlayer: Set a fixed duration for image items.
defaults.noteCrossfade: Crossfade blends visual content while audio changes at the normal item boundary.
defaults.noteCrossfadeAutosave: Crossfade blends visual content while audio changes at the normal item boundary. Changes save automatically.

timeline.heading: Content
timeline.hintTag: Ready media matching the selected tags appears here automatically.
timeline.hintManual: Items play from top to bottom, then loop.
timeline.tagRuleNote: Edit the tag rule under Playlist details to change which content appears here.
timeline.emptyTagDescription: No ready media currently matches this playlist’s tags.
timeline.emptyManualDescription: Add ready images, videos, Widgets, or Layouts to begin playback.

history.intro: The last {{kept}} revisions are kept. Restoring makes a new revision, so it can be undone the same way.
history.title: History
history.restoredWithSkipped_one: Restored revision {{from}} as revision {{to}}. {{count}} item could not be restored because the content was deleted.
history.restoredWithSkipped_other: Restored revision {{from}} as revision {{to}}. {{count}} items could not be restored because the content was deleted.
